description: Revert to the "Gold Standard" configuration (Depth=8, Matrix LR=0.06, Weight Decay=0.1, Batch=128) which has consistently achieved the best val_bpb (~0.9904-0.9905) across multiple runs, as the previous aggressive (0.07 LR) and conservative (0.055 LR) attempts degraded performance, and the capacity increase to Depth=10 failed to converge within the time budget.
